title: Warehouse Operations Executive
summary: A warehouse operations executive runs the daily floor work of a warehouse: receiving goods, putting them away, picking and packing orders and keeping stock counts accurate in the WMS (warehouse management system). The role sits in the warehouse or contract logistics team and leads a shift of associates and contract staff.
dailyDuties: Receive inbound trucks, check goods and post GRNs in the WMS
Plan and supervise picking, packing and outbound loading
Run daily cycle counts and resolve stock discrepancies
Plan shift manpower and allocate pickers and loaders
Carry out 5S and safety checks on the floor
Share daily warehouse MIS on TAT, productivity and stock

skills.expectation: Receive inbound loads, check quantity and quality, post GRNs and put stock away
Plan and supervise picking and packing so orders leave on time
Supervise loading and outbound dispatch and coordinate with transport
Record every receipt, movement and dispatch accurately in the WMS
Run cycle counts, reconcile stock and investigate discrepancies
Plan shifts and supervise loaders, pickers and contract manpower
Keep the floor safe and in 5S order, with PPE and MHE rules followed
Prepare daily warehouse MIS and stock reports in Excel
Lead a shift team of associates and supervisors
Track warehouse KPIs such as productivity, TAT and order fill rate
Pull stock and order reports from SAP or another ERP
Check e-way bills and delivery challans before dispatch
Suggest layout and process changes that cut walking and rework
